h: The Mishkan Opens the Wellsprings of Oral Torah

p: (שִׁיר הַשִּׁירִים ה, א) בָּאתִי לְגַנִּי וְגוֹ׳
(Shir HaShirim 5:1) "I have come into My garden, etc.;
I have gathered My myrrh, etc.;
does so when the food is prepared before him;
The holy Zohar discusses this at length
but does not spell out its answer.
are watered from the stream that never ceases."
"I have come into My garden" as the Mishkan,
וּבַזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (פְּקוּדֵי, חֵלֶק ב רכא, ב)
And in the holy Zohar (Pekudei, II 221b):
'the tribes of Kah, a testimony,' etc.
bear witness in every place," etc.
This refers to the second Luchos,
שֶׁכּוֹלְלִין גַּם כֵּן תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה
which include Torah she'b'al peh as well,
as Chazal said in Midrash Rabbah
(תִּשָּׂא, שְׁמוֹת רַבָּה מו, א וּמז, ז)
And these are the two witnesses, Yud-Hei:
Binah being understanding one thing from another,
And it explains "I have gathered My myrrh, etc."
are watered from the stream that never ceases.
וְהוּא כְּעֵין מַה שֶּׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ
This is like what is written in the holy Zohar
the head of Ze'ir Anpin is filled
with dew that descends from Atika Kadisha,
and it drips onto the Field of Holy Apples";
when the head of Ze'ir Anpin is filled
And it mentions "I have eaten My honeycomb,
the bread of the Written Torah;
the wine of the Oral Torah,
as is written in the holy Zohar
(רַעְיָא מְהֵימְנָא עֵקֶב, חֵלֶק ג רעא, ב)
וְאַחַר כָּךְ אַטִּיל לַחֲקַל תַּפּוּחִין קַדִּישִׁין
and afterward it drips onto the Field of Holy Apples.
also come from Chochmah and Binah:
and Binah, understanding one thing from another;
when He would have given them
and then each one of Yisrael
would have grasped the Oral Torah
contained in the five Chumshei Torah.
the bread of the Written Torah,
corresponding to the five Chumshei Torah
and the Oral Torah is contained in them,
and that is why eating is written of them.
וְהַיְינוּ זִיוּוּג קוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא וּשְׁכִינְתֵּיהּ
that is, the union of HaKadosh Baruch Hu and His Shechinah.
And this is "drink and become drunk,"
which is the wine of the Oral Torah,
פֶּה תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה קָרֵינַן לַהּ
"Peh, we call it Torah she'b'al peh."
And this is the second Luchos,
which contain Midrash, halachos and aggados
that comes to repair the "abundance of anger."
וְאַחַר כָּךְ בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ג ד, ב)
(שִׁיר הַשִּׁירִים ב, יב) הַנִּצָּנִים נִרְאוּ בָאָרֶץ
(Shir HaShirim 2:12) "The blossoms have appeared in the land,
the time of song has come":
of the princes of the nations,
so that they should not rule over them, etc.
which are included in the kelipah of Edom and Yishmael,
And when the Mishkan was erected,
and to nullify all the kelipos;
and they are one with the subjugation by the kingdoms,
so all the powers of the nations will be nullified
"And the voice of the turtledove is heard in our land":
why it does not say "is heard in the land,"
whose essence is in Eretz Yisrael,
"For from Tziyon will go forth Torah,
and the word of Hashem from Yerushalayim";
and there was the Lishkas HaGazis,
from which Torah goes forth to all Yisrael,
And this is why it specified
"which Yisrael inherited by the hand of Yehoshua":
הָיָה נוֹתֵן לָהֶם גַּם סֵפֶר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ
He would have given them the book of Yehoshua as well:
it is the inventory of Eretz Yisrael.
That is, the portion of each one of Yisrael
and each one would have recognized and grasped
his portion in the Oral Torah
And so it is written in the holy Zohar
was said of the Oral Torah;
for as for the Written Torah,
and this was for the Levi'im, etc.
פֶּה תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה קָרֵינַן לַהּ
"Peh, we call it Torah she'b'al peh";
and the Written Torah is called "Torah,"
is also contained in the Written Torah,
and receives from "tor," a masculine term,
is the vitality of the Oral Torah:
And all this is an opening to the pasuk
"And the glory of Hashem filled the Mishkan,"
And so too Shabbos is called
and this is what we say:
"Moshe will rejoice in the gift of his portion,"
וְהָדָא הוּא דִּכְתִיב בָּאתִי לְגַנִּי וְגוֹ׳
"and this is what is written, 'I have come into My garden, etc.,'
for it is written, 'And He called to Moshe':
in whose domain the whole house stands."
